volunteering.title: Teaching Assistant
volunteering.description: I helped young students in S.K and grade 1 develop problem solving skills by allowing them to think through tasks. Additionally, I supported students with advice about how to organize themselves and communicate to others effectively.

li_projects.title: Connect4 Bot
li_projects.description: Training a connect4 AI model to become unbeatable.

li_projects.title: Emotion Detection
li_projects.description: Trained a AI model on the FER2013 to detect in real time what emotion is on your face. Achieved 61% test accuracy, and 65% when I combined 5 unique models into a ensemble.

li_projects.title: Object Scanner
li_projects.description: Using a claude API and TensorFlow, automatically detect what is on the screen and display it in real time.

li_projects.title: Shape Tracking
li_projects.description: In real time, track where your hands are and create various filters between them, including an invisibility one.

li_projects.title: School Programming Event
li_projects.description: Attended 8 different classrooms at Riverside Public School, teaching grades 3-8 about various methods and ways to think through problems in code.

I went to my first ever hackathon...AND GOT SECOND! 🥈 My team and I built RivalRuns, a two-player endless runner inspired by Subway Surfers but without a keyboard or controller. Player A dodges obstacles by moving their body in real life. You can change lanes by stepping side to side, jump, duck, and throw both arms up to activate a shield.
